entities.summary: Daniel Welser is an Austrian professional ice hockey player who retired with the EC Red Bull Salzburg of the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL) and also got his number retired. He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Austria men's national ice hockey team.
